messages:
Riley K.: heads-up: deploy-bot auto-held RC-62 during preflight. SBOM flagged a transitive AGPL dependency and a missing provenance for a small helper binary. putting on hold for legal triage.

deploy-bot: [sbom-check] RC-62 -> HOLD\n- transitive: fastmath/libvec (AGPL-3.0)\n- unsigned: third_party/helper-accel (signature: missing)\n- report: /artifacts/rc62/sbom/1790012345/summary.html

Priya L.: We were scheduled for staggered rollout in the change window tonight. AGPL on a transitive lib is a hard stop for redistribution. Can we surgically remove the helper-accel from the distributed artifact and keep the transitive lib only in build-time tooling (not shipped)?

Nadia (sec): AGPL in a transitive runtime dependency is risky for redistribution unless we can ensure it never ships in the runtime artifact. If libvec is only in build tooling and not packaged in the artifact, legal might be OK. For helper-accel (unsigned), we need it removed or provenance provided. Recommend internal-only canary if engineering can produce a build with helper-accel removed and a manifest proving libvec not included at runtime. Also enable runtime sandboxing flags for canary.

LegalBot: Confirming: AGPL present in shipped runtime = redistribution blocked. If engineering can produce an artifact that omits both the unsigned helper and the runtime copy of libvec, Legal can approve an internal-only canary within ~2 hours. Redistribution will need provenance or an alternative non-AGPL replacement and usually 48+ hours. Please attach the final manifest to this thread.

Riley K.: Ok. Two possible paths: 1) produce runtime-stripped RC (no helper-accel, runtime libs removed) and do internal canary only; 2) replace the transitive with MIT/Apache alternative (longer). Given window, path (1) is fastest. Marco, can your team produce a stripped artifact?

ops-oncall: ops note: if we do internal-only canary, use `--region us-west --canary 1 --internal-only` flag when promoting. Also remember `/deploy quarantine` will lock the artifact.

Marco P.: I can build a runtime-stripped artifact. ETA ~70m. Will kick CI and upload manifest to /artifacts/rc62/stripped. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/68221

QA: Quick test plan: smoke, 5k sample, perf sanity. ETA ~40m after artifact upload.

Nadia (sec): For canary nodes set `RUNTIME_SANDBOX=1` and `MAX_CONNS=8`. We'll run a focused fuzz against the acceleration path. If helper-accel is removed, fuzz scope narrows. Post stacktraces here if anything pops.

Priya L.: Action items set: 1) Marco - produce stripped RC (no helper-accel, no runtime libvec) and upload manifest. 2) QA - run plan. 3) Nadia - confirm sandbox flags. 4) Legal - approve internal-only canary after manifest review. Rollback criteria: any crash in accel path OR error rate >0.5% OR p99 latency increase >45%.

deploy-bot: ops tips:
```
/deploy quarantine rc-62 --reason "sbom/aggil hold"
/deploy promote rc62-stripped --region us-west --canary 1 --internal-only --by @ops-oncall
```

Marco P.: Build done. manifest: /artifacts/rc62/stripped/manifest.json. SHA: sha256:9f8e7d6c5b4a... (truncated). Verified: helper-accel NOT included, libvec not in runtime bundle.

LegalBot: Manifest received. Legal approves internal-only canary (2h signoff window). Redistribution remains blocked until provenance or replacement provided. Please record mitigation ticket SEC-2050.

QA: Smoke + sample run complete. error rate 0.02%, p99 +18ms. Recommend internal canary.

Nadia (sec): Sandbox flags applied on canary nodes. Fuzz running 25m: no crashes so far.

Riley K.: Starting internal-only US-west canary at 21:40 PT. dashboard: https://metrics/release/rc62-usw-internal-canary. Will evaluate at 22:40.

QA: 45m into canary: stable. error rate steady 0.03%, p99 +17%.

Nadia (sec): Fuzz completed 40m: no new crashes. runtime sandbox held.

Riley K.: Canary healthy. Recommendation: keep runtime-stripped artifact for staged customers while Legal pursues provenance. If vendor provides signed provenance for helper-accel and clarifies AGPL usage we can consider redistribution; otherwise plan longer-term replacement. Schedule for global redistribution only after `--confirm-redistribution` flag from Legal.

LegalBot: We'll continue vendor outreach. If vendor supplies provenance or relicensing, we can clear redistribution earlier. For now redistribution blocked; internal-only canary approved and safe.

Marco P.: I'll add a feature flag gating that prevents `deploy-bot` from promoting globally unless `--redistribute-allowed` is set.

deploy-bot: Reminder: to unhold globally after legal sign-off run:
`/deploy unhold rc-62 --by @Riley K. --confirm-redistribution`

Riley K.: Thanks team. Updating release notes: mark runtime-stripped artifact, internal-only canary, perf notes, and SEC-2050. Closing hold for internal canary only. :white_check_mark:

Priya L.: I'll follow up with release communications and add a note to the changelog about the temporary runtime-stripped build.
